dxgive.evidence_source: One of the primary limitations of this study was the use of self-report measures to assess eligibility and outcome. Seven of the adolescents assessed for eligibility scored very low on the BDI and therefore were not eligible. As depression was assessed through self-report, it is unknown whether these adolescents were indeed not depressed, or had difficulty labelling their emotions. ... The decision to use self-reported BDI as a screen for eligibility was based on our preliminary research... It was for this reason that parental reports or structured interview for depression were not considered at the start of the trial.

Source.evidence_source: self-report measures to assess eligibility and outcome. Seven of the adolescents assessed for eligibility scored very low on the BDI; self-reported severe depression according to the DASS
